title: STILL PRESENT (r2): queued rows offer 'Take over manually' but the take-over confirm never renders for a Queued row — the affordance dead-ends
evidence: overflow_actions Queued arm: 'Queued -> list.append([RefcheckStart, RefcheckSkip], case call.hooks.can_take_over { True -> [RefcheckTakeOver] False -> [] })'; row_detail Queued arm: 'case pending_confirm(call.reference_call_id, RefcheckConfirmStart, confirm) { True -> view_start_confirm(call, app, slot, inflight) False -> element.none() }' — only the START confirm; view_take_over_confirm is called ONLY from the Unreachable arm (line 631) and ContactInitiated arm (line 667); server hook: 'can_take_over: status == shared_reference_call.Queued || status == shared_reference_call.ContactInitiated || status == shared_reference_call.Unreachable'
detail: W6 fix added the queued menu entry (hook True for Queued) but no confirm surface: choosing Take over on a queued row closes the menu and renders nothing; the invisible pending confirm can't be confirmed or dismissed.
recommended_fix: Render view_take_over_confirm in the Queued row-detail arm (pending_confirm RefcheckConfirmTakeOver), or gate the menu entry; pin a render test for a queued-row take-over confirm.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): the client's per-row `?slot=` wire format still has no test
evidence: start_check: 'let url = case slot { Some(s) -> url <> "?slot=" <> s None -> url }' — grep of client/test/ for '?slot=' and 'reference_checks_api' returns zero hits; only the server 400 branch is pinned (server/test/integration/reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:1140 start_with_invalid_slot_returns_400_test)
detail: The r2 N8 gap persists: the slot-scoped start URL (slot encoding + query building) is untested client-side, so a slot-encoding rename breaks per-row start silently while server tests stay green.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): single-slot refcheck_edit — an unrelated action choice or success still discards another row's in-progress typed trio
evidence: UserChoseRefcheckAction: 'RefcheckSubstitute -> #(Model(..menu_closed, refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(model, call_id, RefcheckEditSubstitute))), effect.none())' — overwrites any open edit; ApiReturnedRefcheckAction Ok arm: 'let cleared = Model(..model, refcheck_edit: None, refcheck_confirm: None, refcheck_action_inflight: set.delete(model.refcheck_action_inflight, call_id))' — clears unconditionally, even when the success is for a different call_id
detail: r2 N5's always-open form and dead Cancel are fixed, but typed values on row A are still silently dropped when the landlord skips/takes over row B or opens B's edit (no per-call clear).
recommended_fix: On action success/choice, clear refcheck_edit only when edit.call_id == call_id; keep the unrelated row's edit state intact.

title: Correction surface renders the §8.3 sentence twice and the new heading/body deviate from the spec verbatim copy
evidence: view_correction_surface: 'html.text(copy.refcheck_state_awaiting_correction(name, app.first_name))' AND 'html.text(copy.refcheck_correction_heading(name))' + 'html.text(copy.refcheck_correction_body)'; body = "Check with the applicant, update the details here, and we'll send the invitation again." vs UX §8.3 "Check with Aisling, update them here, and we'll send the invitation again." (the state line above already interpolates the applicant name verbatim)
detail: With the form open the landlord sees the §8.3 sentence, then a heading repeating its first half, then a paraphrased repeat ('the applicant'/'update the details here') — duplicate copy that also breaks the verbatim guard.
recommended_fix: Drop the heading/body when the verbatim state line is already rendered (or interpolate first_name and match §8.3 wording exactly); keep one §8.3 sentence.
